descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-12 Important Points · S24 「布局对照 p72 原型，两个模式」 Layout against the p72 prototype, both modes

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T1 Matches the source-of-truth prototype layout (RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html): Important Points sits in the bottom box of the Pre-Round fullscreen editor, the dictation in the top box.（TFA-92590 AC 1） — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U7 Every step is repeated in Nursing Home and must pass in both modes.（UAT TC-12；UAT 3.3；TFA-92590 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given p72 prototype (handoff-docs/RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html) and the app's Pre-Round tab and fullscreen editor in each mode

When Compare side by side: where the points box sits, its label and hint, where '+ Add Point' and the cards sit, the empty-state copy

Then Matches the prototype for each mode

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Human side-by-side review; the reference per mode is Q9 (UAT TC-10 'The Pre-Round tab has two boxes' vs AC 1 'the bottom box of the Pre-Round fullscreen editor' vs the prototype's split). The Nursing Home empty-state copy is also judged automatically in S02 / S17

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S24 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-12.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；辅助：EXPLORATORY · 探索测试 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
